dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple 'O' and 'C' shaped structures are visible along the mid-dorsal axis, characterized by sharp, irregular high-contrast perimeters that transition abruptly from dark pigmented exteriors to light grey/white interior cores.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of solid, high-intensity white clusters concentrated along the upper dorsal ridge and cranial region, exhibiting sharp boundaries without internal tonal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the most prominent mid-body macro-annuli form a curvilinear chain, while the relationship between the central 'O' shape and two adjacent high-intensity blobs forms an obtuse triangular configuration.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced high-contrast micro-spotting localized specifically on the rostrum and around the ocular region.
